Subject: Post-webinar asset delivery & watermarking / SSO registrant mapping

Sarah / Matt —

Thanks again for partnering on last week’s joint webinar. Folks on our side want to confirm timing and the packaging approach for the on-demand asset, plus a couple items that need coordination from your side before we publish: 

1) Recording embargo window: Redwood’s preference is a 48-hour embargo to allow for captioning and watermarking checks. Can you confirm you’re comfortable with that?

2) Watermarking: We need to apply a light sponsor watermark (lower-right, 50% opacity) and a short animated slate at the 0:00–0:04 mark showing sponsor logo and a 5-second legal notice. I’ve attached our watermark spec for your review (watermark-specs.docx). If Brightside has other brand rules, please flag.

3) Registrant SSO mapping: Acme asked that registrant emails be SSO-linked to their CRM record so their CSMs can track engagement. We need to agree on the field mapping and a one-time export. Proposed mapping: registrant_email -> Contact.email, registrant_company -> Company.name, registrant_id -> Contact.external_id. If Acme wants hashed PII instead, we can do a SHA256 export.

4) Slide deck & asset placement: We will host the video on our on-demand hub and push slides (slides-v2.pdf) to the asset card. Please confirm the canonical slide file and any redactions needed for the last slide where we show product screenshots.

5) Transcript & captions: Redwood will generate an English transcript and captions. If you need vendor-provided captions instead, let us know prior to the 48-hour embargo window closing.

Next steps: If you can confirm the watermark placement and SSO field mapping by EOD Thursday (5/7), we’ll start the caption + watermark pass and aim to publish on Saturday morning (5/9) behind the embargo.

Attachments: webinar_recording_final.mp4 (stub), slides-v2.pdf, watermark-specs.docx

Thanks —
Dylan
